documents.text: Bandar Indera Mahkota Indera Mahkota is a township in Kuantan, Pahang, Malaysia. This township was opened in 1983. It is once known as Atabara (before it was developed) and now it is a well-developed residential area. Its postal code is 25200. Indera Mahkota is about northeast of Kuantan Town. The historical tin-mining town of Sungai Lembing is from Indera Mahkota. It is also the main road for road users from Kuantan to use the East Coast Expressway (LPT) via Kuantan Interchange. Indera Mahkota is also more accessible to Sultan Haji Ahmad Shah Airport and Gambang/resort city through Kuantan Bypass Highway.
